correctness.rationale: For 0<epsilon<1/2, left branch 2(1-epsilon)x(1-x) maps (0,1/2) into itself and converges monotonically to L. Right branch 2(1+epsilon)x(1-x) has a unique preimage c of 1/2; (1/2,c) is invariant, and the g^2 polynomial excludes all other fixed points by b^2(b+1)(b-3)<0, so all trapped trajectories converge to U. Other states enter left interval or are exceptional. Uniform measure, mean and variance follow from exact basin length and U-L=epsilon/(1-epsilon^2). Symbolic and numeric tests supplement but do not prove infinite claims.

value.rationale: The exact switching/critical-point coincidence selects a complete, geometrically defined basin and a nonanalytic √ε opening; uniform ensemble mean has a sharp ε^(3/2) term and variance ε^(5/2). This supplies a motivated state-selection answer in the originating eco-dispersal model, where the source focuses on transient times. The exact coefficient is not an arbitrary slice: μ=2 is precisely where F(x)=x switches at the logistic maximum.
